title: Known-object recovery benchmark (ledger item #8) run against the S>3 v2 science-only flagship sample

inputs.name: Cached reference 'unusual object' classes (BAL quasars, Roma-BZCAT blazars, CV/WD binaries, LAEs, SLSN hosts)
inputs.locator: huggingface/local cache: ~/Desktop/CODE_YOU/bigbounce_datasets/aug-011-clean-rerun/recovery_refs_2026-09-02/ (fetched 2026-09-02, reused unchanged for this v2 run)

environment.python: astropy, astroquery, healpy, pandas, pyarrow, numpy
environment.hardware: cpu-only, local (Houston's machine, not the RunPod pod)

original_run.wall_clock: under 1 minute (offline crossmatch stage against cached reference classes)

reproduction.recommended_venue: local CPU (any host with the cached reference_catalogs, or a fresh --fetch-references run from a host that can reach vizier.cds.unistra.fr's TAP query endpoint)
reproduction.est_wall_clock: under 1 minute for --crossmatch once references are cached; 10-40 min for a fresh --fetch-references pass
reproduction.notes: Unlike the v1 recovery_benchmark_preview run (which returned 0 fetched classes due to a VizieR TAP-endpoint connectivity failure), this v2 run reused the successfully cached 2026-09-02 reference fetch (5/11 classes fetched, 4 unavailable for missing RA/Dec columns, 1 with no known catalogue ID) and produced real per-class recovery numbers against the S>3 v2 sample's 1244 rows.

verification: pipelines/p1_highz_tracers/tests/test_recovery_benchmark.py (26 offline unit tests) covers the pure matching/CI/enrichment arithmetic. This run's real output: 1 BAL-quasar positional match (4.2x enrichment, out of 5285 in-footprint references) out of 5 fetched classes; ledger #8's >10x-enrichment/>=5-match confirmed-class bar is NOT met. 0 matches for Roma-BZCAT, CV/WD binaries, LAEs, SLSN hosts.
